command:
cat > /usr/local/sbin/activate-srv-data <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
backing=/var/lib/srv-data.lvm
loopdev=$(losetup -j "$backing" | sed -n '1{s/:.*//;p;}')
if [ -z "$loopdev" ]; then
    loopdev=$(losetup --find --show "$backing")
fi
printf '%s\n' "$loopdev" > /run/srv-data-loopdev
lvmdevices --adddev "$loopdev" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
pvscan --cache "$loopdev"
vgchange -ay vg_srvdata
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/activate-srv-data
cat > /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed physical volume for /srv/data
After=systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/activate-srv-data
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
if ! grep -q '^/dev/mapper/vg_srvdata-lv_data[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab; then printf '%s\n' '/dev/mapper/vg_srvdata-lv_data /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=srv-data-loop.service,x-systemd.after=srv-data-loop.service 0 0' >> /etc/fstab; fi
restorecon -v /usr/local/sbin/activate-srv-data /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service /etc/fstab /var/lib/srv-data.lvm /srv/data 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable srv-data-loop.service
systemctl start srv-data-loop.service
systemctl is-enabled srv-data-loop.service
systemctl is-active srv-data-loop.service
grep -E 'srv-data|vg_srvdata' /etc/fstab
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service
